jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety. 

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m. 
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.

We are looking for a technically minded operator who enjoys practical work and wants to learn new things. You will operate and monitor various advanced machines:

• Tricantors: Separating oil from other materials – high-quality machines that require a delicate touch to operate.
• Shredder: Reducing the size of filter cloths.
• Vogelsang installation: Technical installations that require precision and attention
In addition, you will remain calm and focused when problems arise while multiple machines are running.

Working environment

• Greasy environment – work clothes and boots get dirty and smell of frying oil.
• Hands-on mentality required.
• Willingness to work the night shift.
Working hours

Monday - Friday: 08:00 PM - 04:00 AM

Profile

• You're not afraid to get your hands dirty
• Technical profile is compulsory
• Good knowledge of Dutch, French or English
• Experience as operator or higher education is a plus
• Experience operating Manitou and Komatsu cranes is a plus
• A stable CV

jobs.occupation: Senior Brand Manager Côte d’Or BNX – Equity & Communication
jobs.description:
Communication & Campaign Leadership
 
 

• Lead integrated marketing campaigns across all touchpoints — digital and social, TV, OOH, and in-store activation. 

• Brief, steer, and manage creative agencies (strategic and activation) and media agencies to deliver outstanding work. 

• Develop and execute best-in-class annual communication plans aligned to brand strategy. 

• Track and continuously optimise campaign performance through ROI analysis and brand health KPIs (awareness, consideration, penetration).  

Brand Positioning & Equity
 
 

• Define, strengthen, and evolve the long-term brand positioning for Côte d'Or in BNX in close collaboration with the European Marketing Team. 

• Develop and safeguard the brand equity framework and visual identity guidelines. 

• Ensure consistent brand expression and consumer experience across all touchpoints.  

Media Strategy
 
 

• Own the development and execution of media strategy across paid, owned, and earned channels. 

• Optimise media mix and budget allocation for maximum reach, impact, and efficiency. 

• Build strong, collaborative relationships with media agency partners and stay ahead of emerging media trends.  

Consumer & Category Insights
 
 

• Monitor category dynamics and brand performance using market data and consumer research. 

• Identify emerging consumer needs and translate insights into actionable brand and communication initiatives. 

• Partner with the insights team to build a deep understanding of the BNX chocolate consumer.  

P&L Ownership & Financial Management
 
 

• Own the brand P&L, including forecasting and marketing budget management. 

• Drive net revenue growth and margin performance within your area of responsibility. 

• Work closely with finance to track investment efficiency and ensure delivery against business targets.  

People Leadership
 
 

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of 2 direct reports, supporting their professional growth and performance. 

• Foster a collaborative, high-performance team culture built on trust, curiosity, and ambition.  

Cross-Functional Collaboration
 
 

• Partner closely with category management, shopper marketing, sales, consumer insights, finance, supply chain, and legal teams across BNX. 

• Collaborate with the European marketing organisation to co-develop, adapt, and localise regional campaigns for the BNX market. 

• Act as a key contributor to the broader Benelux brand and marketing community.  

What You Bring
 
 

• Master's degree, preferably in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field. 

• Minimum 7 years of FMCG brand marketing experience. Experience managing local brands preferred. 

• Proven track record in communication strategy, campaign development, and agency management. 

• Experience in brand positioning, equity development, and creative briefing. 

• Strong command of media strategy across paid, owned, and earned channels. 

• Experience leading and developing a team. 

• Benelux market knowledge is a strong plus. 

• Fluent in English and either Dutch or French.  

What We Offer
 
 

• A dynamic, international work environment with iconic global brands 

• Real ownership and accountability from day one 

• A collaborative, people-first culture that celebrates curiosity and learning 

• Competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits, including company car 

• Opportunities for regional and global career growth within Mondelēz 

• Flexible working arrangements and a focus on wellbeing

Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Between 5 to 15 stops/day
• Never on weekends or on holidays
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence and code 95
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!

jobs.occupation: Nexin - Medior / Senior BizTalk and .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established Belgian logistics and distribution company operating nationwide with multiple sites across the country.

The organization manages time-sensitive distribution flows and supplies thousands of retail points daily. As part of its strategic evolution, the company is expanding into new product categories while modernizing its IT landscape.
The environment combines

• A stable SME culture with flat hierarchy

• Long-term employee retention

• High operational criticality

• A strong ongoing digital transformation program

To strengthen the internal IT team, our client is looking for a Medior / Senior BizTalk & .NET Developer (minimum 5 years of experience).
Your role

You will join an experienced internal IT department (infrastructure + development) and actively contribute to the evolution of business-critical applications.

You will:

•  Design, develop and maintain integrations using Microsoft BizTalk Server 2020 and C#/.NET.

• Create and maintain schemas, MAPS, orchestrations, pipelines, ports and adapter configurations.

• Develop .NET components, services and REST/SOAP integrations; work with XML, XSD, XSLT and JSON.

• Write and optimize SQL Server queries and stored procedures, and implement validation, error handling and logging.

• Translate business requirements into technical solutions with business analysts and application owners.

 

Day to day support

• Monitor interfaces and application health; investigate failed exchanges, suspended messages and processing delays.

• Handle daily support requests and production incidents, prioritize business impact and keep users informed.

• Diagnose issues across BizTalk, .NET, SQL Server and connected systems; coordinate resolution with IT teams and external partners.

• Restore processing safely, including controlled message resubmission, and investigate root causes to prevent recurring incidents.

• Maintain support procedures, runbooks and incident records; turn recurring problems into permanent improvements.

 

Quality and delivery

• Test integrations and .NET changes, including failure scenarios, and contribute to code reviews.

• Manage source code in GIT and support deployments with environment-specific configurations and rollback procedures.

• Document interfaces and technical changes, and share knowledge with colleagues.

You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders and operational teams. As a BizTalk and .NET developer, you will work in tandem with another colleague
Work environment

• Multicultural team

• Flat organizational structure

• Short decision-making lines

• Strong collaboration culture

• Fun culture

• On-site presence in Belgium required (with homeworking)

• At least 5 years of professional experience in software development, including proven experience developing and supporting Microsoft BizTalk and C#/.NET solutions, ideally with BizTalk Server 2020.

• Strong C# and .NET Framework skills, with hands-on experience in Visual Studio.

• Practical knowledge of BizTalk messaging, routing, promoted properties, MAPS, orchestrations and pipelines.

• Experience with XML/XSD, XSLT, JSON, REST/SOAP services and adapters such as sFTP and WCF-SQL.

• Solid SQL Server skills and experience troubleshooting integration or application issues in production.

• Experience with GIT, testing and structured deployment practices.

• Ability and willingness to combine development work with daily application support.

• Proven use of AI tools in software development, such as coding assistants for implementation, testing, debugging and documentation, with critical review of generated output and respect for data confidentiality.

• Fluent in Dutch or French, with a good working command of English.

 

Additional assets

• Experience with SAP integrations, EDI/AS2 or other enterprise systems.

• Knowledge of modern .NET, ASP.NET Core, Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus or API Management.

• Experience with CI/CD, PowerShell, monitoring tools, or Jira and Confluence.

• Knowledge of Broadcom Automic for scheduling and monitoring automated jobs and workflows.

 

Soft skills

• An analytical mindset and a methodical approach to troubleshooting.

• Ownership of issues through to resolution, with clear communication and a focus on business needs.

• Ability to manage priorities calmly, collaborate with colleagues and document solutions clearly.

jobs.description:

You’ll work along the order picking line, carefully placing the correct products into boxes according to the foreman’s daily briefing. A typical workday starts with a team meeting where daily goals are discussed. You’ll then get to work picking orders, maintaining a clean and safe workspace at all times. You’ll collaborate with colleagues but are also able to work independently and keep calm during busy periods.

If you’re eager to learn, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a growing international company, apply now and discover the opportunities this role has to offer!

• Strong motivation, regardless of educational background

• Precise working style with great attention to detail

• Able to handle stress and perform well in a busy environment

• Blend of team spirit and independence

• Eager to learn and open to discovering new aspects of the production department

• Maintain a clean and safe workspace

• Fluent in Dutch and/or English
